requirements.quote: `packages/db/src/schema/bench-facts.ts` and a migration: an internal, staff-only schema (bench, sitting date, hall, items listed, items heard, items disposed, minutes per item), global and not tenant data.
The app role has no grants on it; only the worker and internal roles do.
`packages/intelligence/src/bench-facts/`: aggregation from rosters, display boards and status.
Internal uses: call-time estimates (#493), roster reconciliation, coverage (#517) and the data ops console (#514).
requirements.why: Call-time estimates are delivered here (R9, D10). Roster reconciliation, the coverage tracker (#517 is open and has no code) and the data ops console wiring have no consumer yet and belong to separate work.

requirements.quote: A user-facing `bench_facts` surface (a matter's bench card: who sat, dates, listing pace, counts) behind the feature flag `bench_facts`, **off** until counsel clears it; neutral wording only.
Static guards: no field, query or UI string for ratings, rankings, comparisons between judges, outcome rates (grant, dismissal or bail percentages), predictions or sentiment.
The app database role can't read the internal bench-facts tables (a grants test). [type:integration]
With `bench_facts` off, no user-facing route or API returns judge-level data. [type:integration]
A static test fails on any outcome-rate, ranking, comparison or prediction field or string. [type:unit]
Call-time estimates use the internal pace data. [type:integration]

decisions.choice: Restrict the table with REVOKE plus SECURITY DEFINER functions instead of new worker/internal DB roles.
decisions.justification: Only owner/app/clerk roles exist (packages/db/src/client.ts:10) and the worker and web both connect as the app role; a new role needs infra and credentials. Precedent: migrations/0072_staff_parse_yield.sql and 0033_staff_console_reads.sql:21.

decisions.choice: Keep the flag key literally `bench_facts` and relax the docs test regex to allow underscore.
decisions.justification: The issue names the flag `bench_facts`; the docs row regex at packages/flags/src/__tests__/docs.test.ts:16 only allows [a-z0-9.-].

decisions.choice: Resolve hall to bench through an owner-defined, ids-only function over active rosters rather than reading tenant roster tables from the worker.
decisions.justification: bench_roster_entry is FORCE-RLS tenant data (packages/db/src/schema/roster.ts:107); precedent app_board_poll_targets in 0076_display_board.sql:45-46.

decisions.choice: bench_id is nullable and no judge identity is stored; facts are per bench and hall.
The user-facing surface is delivered as the flagged core service plus API route; web card rendering is not built here.
decisions.justification: Legal-gated (#118), ships dark; web UI would add an i18n namespace, stories and actions registry entries with no consumer while the flag is off. If the reviewer wants the card, add a web deliverable under R5.
